articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Network Positioning Technology Design. Field Experiment Demonstrator
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the final part of the study, devoted to software-defined radio network positioning technology design, the results of experimental testing of the SDR demonstrator in the field conditions are presented in terms of checking the operability of the procedures, implemented on the FPGA for collecting primary range differences measurements from eNB SDR testbeds and their secondary processing by the UE SDR testbed with the final estimate of UE coordinates in the Matlab environment. Field tests of the SDR demonstrator were carried out under conditions of eNB SDR testbeds synchronization, close to ideal, and in the line-of-sight conditions between the eNB and the UE SDR testbeds. An accuracy of up to one meter was achieved.

articleTitle: Quantum Neural Networks and Their Potential in Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper explores the application of Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) in the field of traffic prediction, an integral aspect of modern transportation management. Traditional machine learning methods like neural networks, decision trees, and support vector machines have been commonly used for traffic prediction. However, the advent of quantum computing offers promising new directions. QNNs, embodying principles of quantum mechanics, have the potential to handle large, complex traffic datasets with greater efficiency and possibly provide more accurate predictions. Despite being in the early stages of research and development, the potential advantages of QNNs in terms of handling complexity, leveraging quantum superposition, entanglement, and interference make them a compelling area of study. Nevertheless, the practical implementation of QNNs for traffic prediction entails overcoming significant challenges related to quantum computing hardware and the development of new quantum machine learning algorithms and frameworks. Ultimately, QNNs could revolutionize traffic prediction and numerous other fields.

articleTitle: Approaches to the Creation, Pilot Implementation and Organization of Operation and Use of Unmanned Systems and Complexes
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of creating, piloting and organizing the operation and use of unmanned systems and complexes. The factors that characterize the advantages of unmanned aerial systems and determine the intensity of development of the unmanned aviation industry are determined. The results of the analysis of the National practice of introducing unmanned aircraft into production and operational processes are presented. Substantiation of the relevance of the issue under study is presented. The problems associated with the creation, pilot implementation and organization of the operation and use of unmanned systems and complexes are considered. Organizational and managerial measures for the sustainable development of the unmanned systems industry in 2023–2030 are proposed.

articleTitle: Use Digital Twins and the Metaverse to Analysis Data in the Agglomeration Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the methodology of the Metaverse in the context of the use of digital twins for data analysis in two environments based on a mathematical model of the agglomeration transport network using breakthrough technologies. By connecting physical elements related to transport with virtual elements, the Metaverse allows you to simulate a transport network taking into account different performance criteria with alternative changes in the movements of people and all objects of the road network. The article analyzes the completeness of data on datasets from the digital twin of the agglomeration transport network using the algorithm for finding the shortest path between graph points in the classical sense and testing this hypothesis based on the Student’s criterion to obtain the missing complete data through the integration of the digital twin and the Metaverse. One of the limitations of the proposed methodology is computational complexity. This limitation can be eliminated by choosing the R language and the Metaverse implementation software that would have the modules presented in this article. Another limitation of the proposed methodology is the inability to adequately take into account the completeness of the information. Thanks to digital technologies and the adoption of new data concepts based on digital tools, the future of mobility will be hyper automatized, more efficient, reliable and sustainable. Well-known manufacturers and developers use digital doubles to optimize the industry with the help of virtual productions, virtual prototypes for car designs, as well as modeling and testing of technical objects of the transport industry. All vehicles will be hyper-connected to digital platforms and smart devices to configure and exchange data based on transit operations to ensure uninterrupted and continuous operation in the agglomeration. Transport system planning can be carried out virtually in a hyper transport system and quickly respond to changing transport needs or problems. The Metaverse platform embedded in the digital twin should be used to plan the intelligent infrastructure of the system, which will solve the problems of the physical world with elements of a ready-made solution for future design work in the field of traffic management based on the data presented, without taking into account time or other costs. Today it is important to focus on the long-term, most sustainable and most significant areas that can be affected by Metaverse technologies.

articleTitle: Research of the Influence of the Semantics and Syntax of a Text Request on the Image Quality Generated by Neural Network Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the problems associated with the generation of images by modern neural network techniques. The aim of the work is to develop and test methods that allow receiving correct generated images when entering a text request. The subject of the research is the modern neural network online services “Shedevrum” and “Kandinsky 2.2”. The relevance of the study is due to the introduction of neural network techniques in such areas of human life as PR, advertising services and even animation, theater and other arts. Both the main errors that occur when entering a text request in an online application or service, and ways to avoid them are given. To achieve this goal, the tasks of developing and testing an algorithm were solved that make it possible to formalize a text request, make it more “understandable” for interpretation by neural network services, which makes it possible to visually obtain more correct results of image generation compared to a natural language request. The methodological basis of the article is the method of system analysis, empirical, comparative and descriptive methods, as well as the method of generalization.

articleTitle: Environmental, Social, and Governance Factors in Transportation Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the issue of digital maturity and the use of IT trends, as well as how to use the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) methodology for the digital transformation of transport and road complex enterprises. In recent years, more and more attention has been paid to sustainable development, especially in the field of technology. One of the key concepts in this area is ESG as a methodology for the sustainable development of the digital maturity of the enterprise. In the modern world, companies that adhere to the principles of ESG are increasingly recognized and supported by investors and consumers. This is because such companies not only care about their profits, but also about the impact of their activities on the environment and society as a whole. Technology also plays an important role in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals. For example, the use of technologies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions or to improve the quality of life of people in different regions of the world. In addition, technology can help companies become more transparent and accountable to their stakeholders. However, in order for technology to truly contribute to sustainable development, it is necessary to take into account not only economic, but also social and environmental aspects. For example, the development of new technologies should take into account their impact on the environment and human health, as well as the social consequences of their use. In general, the direction of ESG in the field of technology is an important step towards sustainable development. Companies that pay attention to these aspects can receive significant support from investors and consumers, as well as contribute to solving global problems related to improving the quality of life and implementing ESG services. Based on an integrated approach, which includes the use of various tools and methods to achieve sustainable development goals in the road complex.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Basic Image Generation Methods by Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article compares the main existing neural network methods that allow you to get images by entering a text request in an application or online service. The purpose of the work is to analyze modern neural network methods for generating images. The relevance of this work is due to the high demand for the use of images generated by neural networks in many areas of human life, such as advertising services, goods, business processes, animation and design. Achievement of this goal is ensured by solving the following tasks: consideration of on-line services based on different methods of image generation, determination of their advantages and disadvantages, identification of general patterns of image generation for each method. The basic principles of image generation by each of the considered neural network methods are presented. The methodological basis of the article is a descriptive method, methods of theoretical analysis, as well as a generalization method.

articleTitle: Megatrends of Digital Engineering Technologies: Analysis of the Model of Integral Assessment of the State and Potential of Digital Development in the Conditions of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Modern technological advances based on the use of electricity and natural electromagnetic forces open up the possibility of developing new cultural environments, which, in turn, reveals the deep potential of humanity. The article analyzes the model of integral assessment of the state and potential of digital development in the context of the Fourth industrial revolution. The study covers various aspects of digital transformation, including technological, economic and social aspects. The authors present a model that allows a comprehensive assessment of the current state and future potential of digital development in various sectors of the economy. The results of the study can be useful for making strategic decisions in the field of digital development, both at the level of public policy and at the corporate level. The authors of the article strive to provide readers with the tools and understanding necessary for effective management and use of the opportunities provided by the fourth Industrial Revolution.

articleTitle: Features of Risk Management of Digital and Infocommunication Development to Ensure a Unified Information Space of Companies in Modern Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article examines the features of risk management associated with the digital and information development of companies in modern conditions. The problems arising in the creation and provision of a single information space of companies are considered, and strategies and methods of risk management in this area are proposed. The article also analyzes the impact of digital technologies and information communication on the modern business environment and highlights key aspects that need to be taken into account when developing risk management strategies. The purpose of this article is to identify the features of the implementation of digital transformation management mechanisms in companies. These mechanisms are aimed at creating a new level of coordination of the organization’s business processes, as well as at assessing the risks associated with them.

articleTitle: Raising Awareness of Driverless Cars at Closed Intersections Using Urban Infrastructure, Machine Vision Technologies and V2X Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: To ensure the safe operation of unmanned vehicles, it is necessary that the vehicle receives sufficient information about the road situation and other road users. But with different scenarios of movement, the amount of necessary information will be different. In the course of model experiments at the landfill, the possibility of interaction of the digital infrastructure of the road network with an unmanned vehicle through a dynamic digital traffic map is shown to increase the awareness of an unmanned vehicle about the real road situation at a closed intersection. Hardware and software for such a system in the form of the INVIAN-X2V machine vision module have been tested. The accuracy of determining vehicle movement parameters achievable at this stage of development of machine vision technologies for further transmission to a digital road map has been determined.

articleTitle: Automatic Control Methods as the Basis for the Development of Intelligent Urban Traffic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A constructive way of automatic control methods application to traffic lights regulation of intersections is proposed. The main idea is to determine the traffic lights phases’ duration for the next traffic lights cycle to improve the indicators of traffic efficiency relying on their values for preceding cycles; the ways of their determination by local traffic situation monitoring are presented. The organization of computational experiments for the choice of the most proper method and its parameters for a certain traffic situation is proposed; it uses the statistical distribution of temporal headways in vehicles’ clusters. The efficiency of automatic control methods for a set of traffic situations on a certain T-junction is studied and the average vehicle delay decrease for some of them is confirmed. Limitation of local application of the proposed methods resulting from the condensed traffic on exit roads may be overcome by coordinating traffic control at neighboring intersections.

articleTitle: Network Multichannel Communication Development Plan
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The development of network multichannel communication is facilitated by the need to monitor roads and the potential to establish high-quality and relatively cost-effective communication networks through these systems, which can be utilized by both highway services and telecommunications operators. This paper explores the principles of creating such networks, the prerequisites for their development and planning approaches. In the planning process, with the aim of minimizing capital expenses, the use of dynamic programming methods is proposed, taking into account the discounting of costs over time. An example is provided along with calculations.

articleTitle: Data Transmission with Priority Service and Limited Capacity Storage in Unstationary Flow and High Load
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Subject of research. The influence of priority service in a multichannel data transmission system with drives of limited capacity and high load with a non-stationary nature of the intensity of packets entering the system and service time in channels. Method. Calculation and analysis of the functional characteristics of a multichannel system is realized using simulation methods and mathematical statistics. Main results. A simulation model of a multichannel system with priority service is proposed to calculate the functional characteristics of a multichannel system with a high load. A number of experiments were carried out on the influence of priority maintenance on the efficiency and reliability of the system. Dependencies between stationary and non-stationary functional quantities have been identified. Practical significance. The presented research results can be used in the design of real multithreaded data transmission systems with a highly heterogeneous load.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of V2X Model with a Mobile Road Side Units
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to analyze the performance of the element interaction model in Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET). Specifically, it focuses on the mathematical model of edge device interaction system in traditional roadside unit (RSU) placement configuration, which involves communication between on-board units (OBU) and RSU using single or dual channels. The paper also investigates the utilization efficiency of mobile road side units (mRSU) and its impact on the percentage of unprocessed requests (data loss) in both OBU-RSU and OBU-mRSU systems during network operation.

articleTitle: Application of ITS Research Laboratories in the Field of Cooperative Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of evaluating the operational performance of intelligent transport system (ITS) subsystems and their individual elements with the help of mobile research laboratories. Conducting operational tests is an important part of monitoring the quality of ITS projects, and the results of such tests can be used to justify modernization projects. Research laboratories can be completed in various configurations. For example, a complex consisting of laboratories conducting tests related to communication and communication in ITS projects can be formed. Separately described laboratories such as cooperative intelligent transport system (C-ITS) mobile laboratory, laboratory of communication systems and high-precision positioning, information security laboratory, laboratory of V2X service platforms and highly automated vehicle (HAV) laboratory. The article also lists the main key performance indicators (KPIs) that can be determined using the laboratories listed in the article.

articleTitle: Interaction of Highly Automated Vehicles with Personal Mobility Devices in the Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is describing an issue of interaction between a person moving with the help of personal mobility devices (PMD) and other participants in the movement. Statistics of road accidents involving similar vehicles are also provided. Special attention is paid to the recognition of such vehicles with the example of an e-scooter by means of technical vision, which is a part of current driver assistance systems and highly automated vehicles. The results of a full-scale experiment on the recognition of a person moving on an electric e-scooter are presented. Several conflict scenarios involving personal mobility devices and a car are considered, occurring in urban traffic conditions, which can lead to an emergency situation of a collision between a car and a person on a PMD. The influence of a combination of failed infrastructure and PMD on the possibility of an emergency situation is also shown. The results of computer modeling of these scenarios are presented.

articleTitle: Application of a Smart System for Developing Interactive Tests in Teaching Communication Theory Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Testing as an effective way to test students’ knowledge in technical universities is increasingly used. One of its main advantages is the minimum time spent on obtaining control results. When testing, electronic and interactive versions of tasks are often used. The latter are especially convenient for the teacher, as they allow you to get results almost immediately upon completion of the test and minimize the possibility of falsifying the results. The article analyzes a modern smart system for developing interactive tests at the level of higher technical education, proposes methods for developing tests for technical disciplines, and illustrates examples of tests developed and implemented in the educational process for disciplines of communication theory.

articleTitle: Principles of the Formation of Physical and Functional ITS Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the requirements for the construction of the physical and functional architecture of intelligent transport systems (ITS), taking into account the experience of the development of equipment and technologies in the field of ITS, cooperative systems and highly automated vehicles. The article reflects the basic principles of building the functional and physical architecture of ITS. When developing ITS architectures, the structure of ITS construction is considered, where the integration platform includes modules of ITS complex subsystems. The architectures should reflect the parts related to information security, as well as ensuring the interaction of ITS with external information systems and the national network of ITS. For a clearer understanding of the structure of ITS in architectures, the level of the information and telecommunications network is considered, which is the link between the instrumental subsystems of ITS and the element base of ITS.

Author Keywords: highly automated vehicle ITS integration platform

articleTitle: Using a Digital Twin in Ultra-Large-Scale System
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the possibility of using digital twin in Ultra-Large-Scale System (ULSS) on the example of the dynamic system “Intelligent electronic hitch”. ULSS it combines big data, complex algorithms for their processing and dynamic control processes of various levels in real-time. The sustainable development of ULSS depends on the effectiveness of the organization of interaction between its components, taking into account the properties of heterogeneity and self-organization. The capabilities of digital twin ensure the successful solution of modeling, analysis, management and forecasting tasks in ULSS. The application options of digital twin are considered on the example of the dynamic system “Intelligent electronic hitch”. The application of digital twin is considered in the following aspects: the realization of the possibility of forecasting and optimizing tasks for the implementation of the main activity of the control object; the realization of the possibility of issuing recommendations for control actions based on predictive analytics data obtained in real time; the realization of the possibility of making functional and structural changes to the life cycle of a physical object. The article proposes the implementation of types digital twin: component twin, asset twin, system twin and process twin at different levels of integration of smart-controller and “Intelligent electronic hitch” in ULSS.

articleTitle: Road Infrastructure Optimization to Improve the Energy Efficiency of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Under current conditions, prompt and consistent steps are required to reduce energy consumption in the transport sector and increase the sustainability of transport infrastructure. Since the share of environmentally friendly vehicles is growing relatively slowly, additional efforts are required to reduce the fuel consumption of the existing vehicle fleet. The article uses a method for assessing road infrastructure from the point of view of the rationality of installation sites for road signs, provides theoretical background, conducts road tests and analyzes the results obtained in comparison with existing best practices. The method under consideration was analyzed using initial data obtained from transport detectors and telematic surveillance data. The study showed that eco-driving methods have a good effect on fuel economy only with rationally designed road infrastructure. The method is applicable for adjusting the installation locations of road signs when analyzing the reasons for increased energy consumption of transport.

articleTitle: The Software of Control System for Collective Work of the Technical Developments
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper examines the results of software development for a system for collective work of users on a single engineering task. The software is developed using open source principles and supports the integration of registered users into the content generated and data sources used. The development is based on the creation of a database protected at the software architecture level. The software consists of modules and provides engineering component database management solution capabilities responsible for storing and retrieving information about existing and potential components, devices, materials and technologies used in projects. Along with providing connections, real-time processing of user requests to the metadata database is carried out. High performance and integration with mobile devices are ensured by reducing response time and increasing the availability of the system and its services through the use of distributed data storage.

articleTitle: Modular Software Environment for Distributed SDR Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents a new modular software environment for distributed software-defined radio (SDR) systems or data processing systems. The software environment is designed to release real-time signal processing systems with the functionality of distributing tasks across available computing resources. Elementary tasks of signal or data processing are represented as modules, which are combined into processing Tract through inter-module connections. Processing scenarios that combine elementary tasks are executed on computing resources in the form of processing Tracts and workflows (Workers). Workers communicate with each other through the functionality of network interfaces and universal messaging. Setting up inter-module connections, network data transmission, as well as interaction between universal messages and module parameters allow to perform a flexible system configuration without the involvement of programmers. The environment as a whole is controlled by the System Core, which is configured via the console or web interface. At the same time, the architecture of the software environment allows you to fully perform tasks without the System Core.

articleTitle: Vehicle Driver Condition Monitoring System Based on Electrocardiographic Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper discusses the analysis of ECG (electrocardiogram) in order to determine the moment of transition from a state of wakefulness to a state of drowsiness of the vehicle driver. A portable device for getting ECG using the first standard lead has been developed. The signal is collected using electrodes built into the steering wheel or driver’s vest and transmitted to a processing device via Bluetooth technology. A spectral analysis of the recorded ECG is carried out using the method of R.M. Baevsky. A decision-making algorithm has been developed and implemented to detect the driver’s transition from wakefulness to drowsiness, if detected, an alarm is generated.

articleTitle: Development of an Electronic Control System a New Generation of Airfield Irrigation Machine Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article provides a comprehensive over view of the aerodrome surface maintenance machine, namely the aerodrome irrigation machine (AIM) and its complex control systems. The developed components of the AIM designed for servicing airport runways are also described. Special attention is paid to complex equipment, modern automation and integration of electronic control. The article discusses in detail the features of the hydraulic system, control parameters, feedback from sensors and the operator’s control panel. Control systems for the central brush, power take-off and lighting are being developed, with an emphasis on safety features such as automatic shutdown in emergency situations. In general, it highlights the importance of highlighting the advanced technologies and multi-faceted functions inherent in AIM, which are crucial for efficient maintenance of the airport infrastructure.

articleTitle: Maintaining Safety in the System of the New Urban Mobility
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main task of the leadership of any city is to ensure the protection of citizens from various dangerous impacts. In relation to vehicles, hazardous effects are: the consequences of an accident, environmental pollution, increased noise and vibration. In the modern megapolis, new categories of vehicles have appeared, such as: means of individual mobility, bicycle transport, motor transport and new types of transport services, for example: carsharing, kicksharing, taxi, delivery of goods by bicycle and motor transport. All this becomes the new urban mobility, creates a new vehicle structure and begins to affect safety in the city. Safety problems associated with new categories of vehicles and ways to solve them are discussed in the article.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of the Implementation of Research Work on the Basis of Higher Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with issues related to the implementation of research work on the basis of higher educational institutions. Approaches of efficiency improvement for the development of science in a higher educational institution in modern economic conditions are determined. The points of cooperation between higher educational institutions and enterprises of the real sector of the economy are shown. The directions for the development of applied scientific research and development of higher educational institutions are determined. Methods of sustainable development of science in higher education institutions and proposals for the creation of a unified research and development management system are presented.

articleTitle: Research Multiservice Access Networks when Transmitting Heterogeneous Traffic
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The architectural concepts future networks for the construction highly efficient multiservice access networks supporting a wide range of infocommunication services are analyzed. Based on the research, a mathematical model of the performance communication networks using end-to-end digital technologies and with limited channel and network resources is proposed. Suggested models, complex indicators service and information networks performance such as network bandwidth, efficient use resources and probabilistic-temporal characteristics networks when performing various infocommunication services are investigated. As a result, formulas were obtained for assessing the network performance indicators of the system and its terminal equipment.

articleTitle: Adaptive Method to Increase Vehicle Detection System Robustness on Blurred and Noisy Aerial Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of neural-based detection of vehicles on blurred and noisy images of remote sensing is considered. The aim of this study is to improve the performance of object detection in aerial images exposed to distortions of various nature. This aim is achieved using the proposed technique, which includes optimal training images augmentation and an adaptive input data preprocessing reducing the impact of high-frequency noise. The simulation results, carried out on the publicly available DOTA aerial images dataset, show that the application of optimal robust training and the use of the proposed adaptive system simultaneously allow to obtain a more robust neural-based vehicle detection system for various tasks of remote sensing.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Design of the Airfield of Aerodrome Equipment Using its Modeling in the Software Package
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The use of modern computing technologies makes it possible to achieve higher pragmatic and financial results in various industries. At the same time, information technologies used in the field of engineering design are rapidly developing. The number of various computer modeling programs is also growing. This article presents a three-dimensional image of the configuration of a metal frame with the following calculation of the loads acting on it. This analysis is performed using the ANSYS Workbench 16.2 software package, in particular, using the additional Static Structural module. Load diagrams are presented and graphical representations are generated illustrating the schemes of moving a carefully studied structural component for four cases of moving specialized equipment at an airfield. The kinetic characteristics of vehicle movement and coupling coefficients relative to the roadway are being studied. This effort entails the output of numerical values necessary for the developed system, related to the quantitative assessment of both contact and non-contact forces. In the course of the study, distinctive load values along the main triaxial axes of the superstructure structure are determined for each individual type of movement. The problem areas in which potential violations of structural integrity may occur are identified. Based on the collected data, a conclusion is made that makes it possible to develop the design of an airfield irrigation and washing machine. This design iteration serves to eliminate deficiencies and correct inaccuracies that may be present during the further operation of specialized airfield equipment.

articleTitle: Implementation of Classification Algorithms for Data Traffic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article poses the task of analyzing network traffic using machine learning methods. The division of instant message service traffic into classes of possible user activities is made, the following classes are selected for markup: text, video, idle. Methods of mathematical statistics, machine learning are used, k-NN and Random Forest algorithms are compared, training is implemented by the Kohonen network. In the course of research on the example of the one of the information exchange applications, a method based on statistical analysis of network traffic, which does not require the study of the contents of the packages, was applied. As a result, the classifier is implemented, which can help to analyze data traffic. The efficiency of the classifier is demonstrated and the efficiency tested by cross-validation. The difference between the developed algorithms and the known ones is in the ability to effectively classify and track traffic without studying and decrypting the contents of packages.

articleTitle: Modernization of Bucket Cutting Edge Using Software Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Various types of buckets are widely used in the road construction industry. Each bucket has its own unique design feature and range of tasks. The work is devoted to the study of acting loads on the bucket and modernization of the cutting edge of the bucket using software modeling. Often the bucket has not a long service life and in case of failure, only the manufacturer’s enterprises or highly specialized organizations can perform qualified repair. The calculation of operational characteristics was made, which revealed weak areas, where mechanical damage is possible in the future. A unique design of the bucket device has been developed, which allows to reduce pressure on the weak areas of the bucket, to unify the tasks and use the bucket in different conditions, as well as to have the possibility of prompt repair in the conditions of road construction works.

articleTitle: Detection of Abnormal Traffic Flow with the Hurst Parameter for Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In order to further reduce emissions of particulate matter, nitrogen oxides and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere from road transport, the causes of congestion on city streets should be eliminated. The movement of transport in urban conditions is quite cyclical, however, in the conditions of each city it has its own specifics. The use of adaptive traffic light control systems within the framework of intelligent transport systems (ITS) contributes to solving this problem. However, there is a need not only to directly respond to traffic jams and reduce the speed of vehicles, but also to predict these situations in advance. The article shows an example of using the normalized range method (Hurst exponent) for predictive detection of changes in traffic flow indicators on a city highway for subsequent correction of traffic lights.

articleTitle: Accumulation of Interference of Modulation Schemes of Communications in Saturated Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The continuous growth in high-volume transport stream demand necessitates spectrally efficient modulation schemes resilient to interference. This research investigates interference accumulation in trellis-coded modulation (TCM), differential quadrature phase shift keying (DQPSK), offset quadrature phase shift keying (OQPSK), Feher-patented quadrature phase shift keying (FQPSK), and differential binary phase shift keying (DBPSK). Interference is modeled as a non-stationary stochastic process with random power fluctuations. Mathematical modeling and simulations quantify and characterize the interference resilience of each scheme. Results demonstrate OQPSK exhibits the highest resilience due to its constant envelope and time-offset transmissions. In contrast, DQPSK and DBPSK are highly susceptible to performance degradation from interference. This research provides interference models and performance assessments to identify optimal modulation techniques for emerging high-volume transport stream applications and inform standards development

articleTitle: Studying the Capabilities of Neural Networks for Adaptive Driver Assistance Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The global vehicle fleet continues to grow, and the number of accidents on the roads increases accordingly. The main causes of road accidents are driver distraction while driving, drunkenness or speeding. Most of all accidents occur on roads that are not sufficiently equipped with safety elements. On high-speed roads, which are better equipped than other roads, roadway defects, uneven junctions, etc. can still occur, which can also cause accidents. Improving road safety and reducing the number of accidents is the main direction in the development of the system driver-car-road-environment. From the point of view of improving the safety of the car, the main task is to increase the degree of automation of the car. At the moment, there is a tendency to further transfer the functions of driving the car from the driver to the appropriate systems.

articleTitle: Methodology for Implementing Neural Networks into the Management of Marketing Communications of Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the features of the use of neural networks by companies. The use of neural networks allows them to increase the efficiency of their activities, but not everyone understands how neural networks can be integrated into business processes. In the existing scientific field, there is no precise understanding of how neural networks should be implemented in marketing communications. The author will propose in the article a methodology for introducing neural networks for specific business tasks within the framework of managing marketing communications of companies. The purpose of the study is to determine the algorithm for introducing neural networks into the management of marketing communications of companies. The author offers his own methodology that allows companies to implement this tool optimally for improving the efficiency of the entire business. The method of critical analysis of literature on the research issues was chosen as the main research method. In achieving this goal, a number of general scientific research methods were used: analogy, analysis, synthesis, problematization, deduction and induction, schematization, comparative analysis method, abstraction, criticism, categorization. The conclusions based on the results of the empirical study are presented. The article concludes with recommendations for further research related to the use of neural networks by companies. The work was carried out within the framework of the SUM grant (Research No. 4009-23) “Identification of marketing trends and their application in promoting companies”.

articleTitle: Analytical Model of the Organization of Freight Traffic in the Intelligent Transport System of the Metropolis
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the article the principles of mathematical modeling of the implementation of object-oriented approach in the information space of possible solutions for the organization of freight transportation in the metropolis are formed. The implementation of this principle involves the division of the investigated system into subsystems based on the signs of homogeneity of technology and heterogeneity of information states: at the macro level in the information system of the metropolis, these are separate transport enterprises with appropriate production capabilities; at the micro level in the information system of the transport enterprise these are separate technologies (route type or vehicle type) The developed mathematical model allows you to simulate the change in variables over time for a particular process from the perspective of multivariable forecasting, in relation to any process of organizing freight transportation, depending on the information situation corresponding to the conditions of the process.

articleTitle: Application of Grover’s Algorithm in Route Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Route determination and optimization is a persistent challenge in transportation networks due to combinatorial explosion of options, dynamically changing conditions, competing optimization criteria, and complexity of real-world systems. Classical algorithms struggle to efficiently solve route optimization at scale due to exponential growth of possibilities, NP-hardness, limitations of dynamic programming approaches, and inability to leverage quantum parallelism. This paper explores the potential application of Grover’s algorithm in optimizing road transportation. Grover’s quantum algorithm offers a potential solution by using an oracle function to recognize optimal routes based on constraints and objectives encoded in a quantum state representing all possible paths. Constructive interference and amplitude amplification drive the system toward optimal solutions. By utilizing Grover’s algorithm, road transportation networks can benefit from improved route planning, traffic management, and resource allocation, ultimately enhancing efficiency and reducing congestion. The transportation network must be efficiently encoded into a quantum representation. An optimization oracle tailored to routing objectives then recognizes optimal solutions, which are amplified via a diffusion operator utilizing interference. Repeated application concentrates amplitude in optimal routes, which can be measured. Key challenges include encoding the network effectively within qubit resource constraints, designing an oracle to evaluate routes based on real-world conditions and optimization criteria, and translating the optimized quantum state into actionable routing guidance. If these challenges can be met, Grover’s algorithm may enable route optimization at a scale intractable for classical techniques.

articleTitle: Methodology for Selecting Neural Network Architecture for Recognizing Pavement Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A methodology for selecting a neural network architecture for recognizing pavement defects is proposed. The defect list detected by the computer video scanning system of the mobile complex for the multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of street and road network objects “ADS-MADI” is specified. The analysis results of several primary neural network architectures that satisfy the requirements for the highest possible accuracy with sufficient cost-effectiveness of their use are presented. The topology of the DeepLabV3 neural network is presented for the input images that were collected during the monitoring of the Moscow street and road network by a hardware and software complex consisting of linear cameras, making it possible to obtain homogeneous images of the roadbed without splices and the use of specialized software. The training results of the neural network for 25 epochs using the weights pre-trained on the Pascal VOC 2007 dataset are presented, along with plots of the error and change functions of F1 and IoU during training. The results of hyperparameter optimization using the Bayesian optimization-based HyperBand algorithm are contained, significantly reducing errors and improving the accuracy of the neural network. Results comparing the performance of the three best-fit architectures are presented.

articleTitle: Application of Morphological Operations and Hough Transform for Recognizing Objects in an Image when High Intensity Glare Occurs
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of recognizing in a photo image a large number of similar objects, the illumination of which is characterized by glare of high intensity (with a complex transmission coefficient of the optical system). Examples of such objects are glass bottles or test tubes. High-intensity glare blurs the boundaries of objects up to their visual merging. The authors chose the Hough Transform as the main methods of recognition. With properly chosen parameters, the transform recognizes both circles (disks) and circles equally well. However, for the second case, as practice shows, circles must be continuous. To fulfill this condition, the image must be subjected to preprocessing (Gaussian filter, Radon transform, etc.). In particular, the paper considers the application of morphological operations (dilatation, erosion) for image preprocessing. After the Hough transform the obtained list of circles is subjected to classification by radius and mutual location, which allows to increase the reliability of recognition

articleTitle: Carrying Out Fault Tolerance Tests of Automatic Emergency Braking Systems to Prevent Collisions with a Bycyclist
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The most typical scenarios for collisions with bycyclists have been established. The weather and road conditions of such accidents for countries with cold climates have been identified. 5 types of test scenarios are proposed to assess the fault tolerance of the system. Test scenarios include testing the failure tolerance of the automatic emergency braking systems (AEBS) in good and poor lighting, on dry and wet asphalt concrete pavement. The AEBS fault tolerance assessment system includes weight coefficients for individual types of tests. An experimental study of the failure-tolerance of the AEBS of the Nissan Pathfinder R53 was carried out at the central scientific research automobile and automotive engine institute (NAMI) automobile test site. A movable mock-up of a bycyclist was used in the tests. To record test data, VN1630 and VN5620 equipment units from Vector Informatik GmbH were used. A graphical analysis of the functioning of the automatic braking system at the stage of automatic braking is presented.

articleTitle: Methods for Optimizing the Deformation-Strength Characteristics of Polymer Concrete
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This study investigates boundary value problems for the equation of motion of an oscillator with viscoelastic damping when the damping order is greater than zero but less than two. Such problems model various physical processes, including the oscillation of a string in a viscous medium, changes in the deformation and strength properties of polymer concrete under loading, and others. This work provides a justification for the method of variable separation for the equation of string oscillation with friction in a medium with fractal geometry. In numerous articles on this topic, when using the method of separation of variables, there is often a previously nowhere proven statement about the absence of associated functions in the associated boundary value problems. In this paper, in particular, this important assertion is proved. The Green’s function (influence function) is also investigated, studied problem. It is proved that this Green’s function (influence function) is non-negative, which makes it possible to establish the main oscillatory properties of the problem under consideration.

articleTitle: A method for Constructing an Urban Public Transport Network Based on the Assessment of Traffic Flows by ITS Detectors
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The problem of adapting existing urban public transport networks for large cities remains relevant, as it requires quite expensive methods of collecting primary information about the movements of urban residents using tracking from cellular network signals, fare transactions or large-scale statistical surveys. The article compares the results of constructing a matrix of correspondence between residents of a large city based on three methods of collecting initial information: a statistical study of the transport demand of residents, the use of online surveys and modeling of potential demand based on the use of data from detectors of the city’s intelligent transport system (ITS). It is shown that, despite the significant difference between the methods and the resources spent, the last two methods give comparable results. In connection with the large-scale implementation of ITS in world practice, the latter method can be used to quickly and fairly accurately assess the uncovered transport needs of urban public transport networks. The article confirms the hypothesis about the formation of almost identical passenger flows by private car and public transport in travel areas, with little interest of citizens in using the latter for everyday trips.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Convolutional Neural Network Based on Systolic Matrix Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper, we consider possibility of using matrix multipliers in hardware implementation of convolutional neural networks. Literature review has been conducted, existing matrix multiplication methods and their hardware implementations has been analyzed. Systolic algorithm for matrix multiplication (SMM) based on divide-and-conquer approach is proposed. This algorithm has been implemented as parameterized generator of hardware descriptions. Its positive and negative aspects are identified. Main difficulties of preparing feature maps for matrix multiplication are analyzed. Comparative analysis of hardware implementations of MobileNet neural network has been carried out for implementations based on convolutional blocks and implementations based on systolic matrix multiplier. A combined method is proposed that has the advantages of both approaches.

articleTitle: Development of Approaches to Updated Database on the Vehicle Fleet of Various Countries for Assessing Gross Greenhouse Gas Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The vehicular emission modelling software COPERT is extensively used in generating emission levels for National Emissions Inventory in Europe and in some other countries internationally. This software has a wide functionality and a flexible approach to the calculation of greenhouse gas emissions. Thus, COPERT presents more than 373 vehicle categories (groups), each of them differs in classification and attributive characteristics: category, fuel type, Euro emission standard, load capacity and engine capacity. Meanwhile, the practical use of this program is constrained by the need to collect a large volume of structural, technical and operational, road, climatic and other significant indicators used in COPERT as input data. Correctly taken into account the detailing of the fleet reduces uncertainties in the assessment of total gross emissions, which is especially important when assessing the statistical uniformity of time series of emissions. To do this, it is necessary to perform statistical processing and cluster analysis of available databases to form a relational database of all single vehicles. Within the framework of this work, such a relational database is demonstrated, formed on the basis of the Rosstat database (form 1-BDD) and the analytical agency “Autostat”. This work is devoted to the development of algorithms and methods for correcting information (noisy data) when they are included in a relational database for all single vehicles that were in the car fleet in the period from 2010 to 2022 (about 60 million units every year), and the implementation of their clustering into COPERT calculated model groups using artificial intelligence elements. The results of this work may be relevant for a number of countries with a lack of representativeness of data in state vehicle accounting systems and seeking to account for greenhouse gas emissions by tier 3 according to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change guidelines. Data flow management, availability of advanced storage systems, organization of information processing taking into account the recovery of missing data – all these key elements are necessary to confirm and verify the input parameters used to calculate greenhouse gas emissions in the COPERT program at the national level.

articleTitle: Managing the Artificial Intelligence Technologies for the Higher Education Sphere
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article’s main purpose is to identify the principles for the artificial intelligence technologies’ implementation in higher education. The article is largely devoted to the selection of individual algorithms and mechanisms for the transition and implementation of artificial intelligent technologies in the educational environment, taking into account the existing international experience. The basic method for analyzing the identified problem is the synthesis of an algorithm for introducing artificial intelligence technologies into the educational environment, taking into account maintaining the competitiveness of universities. The Beijing Consensus, which is based on the principles of sustainable development of the United Nations, was used as the main reference point for the analysis. Among the general scientific methods used were: analysis, synthesis, generalization, problematization, and the authors also conducted a study using the case study method. The article results in a step-by-step algorithm for introducing artificial intelligence technologies into the educational environment, taking into account the requirements of modern technologies.

articleTitle: Problems of Combining NOMA with MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article reviews existing methods for combining non-orthogonal access technology (NOMA) and multiple input – multiple output (MIMO), and analyzes the results of current research in this area. Developing new MIMO-NOMA systems brings new signal processing and formation challenges such as grouping of users’ signals and complexity of their joint processing. Along with MIMO-NOMA multi-cluster systems, open loop and closed loop systems are considered. Simulation results are presented to compare the noise immunity of users with different type of modulation scheme selected in one cluster of closed loop and open loop MIMO-NOMA system for independent Raleigh fading channel. The main problems associated with the development of methods and algorithms for combining NOMA and MIMO technologies are also formulated.

articleTitle: Environmental, Social, and Corporate Governance Perspectives in Development of Quantum Vector Databases Based on Grover’s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Large language models have a big influence on spheres that require data analysis and information retrieval, one of those fields is Environmental, social, and corporate governance (ESG), a field that depends on analyzing and finding correlations in big amounts of varied data from multiple sources. This paper introduces a quantum computing approach using Grover’s algorithm to create a vector database that stores embeddings based on Controlled-S gates, with each embedding represented by a binary numerical value. The creation of these embeddings, is conducted by a classical computer, while the quantum computer handles the search process through the database. This method is very efficient in terms of qubits, enabling large amounts of data to be stored within a single quantum register. And the use of quantum computers has the potential to make querying this database quick and power-efficient. By making use of this approach, managers, investors and policymakers can make informed decisions based on a wider range of ESG data, ultimately promoting environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and good corporate governance

articleTitle: Development of a Network Computer Laboratory for Training in Road Traffic Simulation and Model Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper focuses on creating a network computer laboratory (NCL) for training in traffic simulation model verification using up-to-date web application technologies. The significance of this web development is growing with the extensive use of information technology, especially distance learning. The NCL is based on original mathematical models of traffic flows, particularly the macroscopic quasi-gas dynamic traffic model and multilane model of cellular automata. The platform is built using ASP.NET Core to create cross-platform web applications, using the Model-View-Controller (MVC) design pattern. The NCL includes a knowledge base of various models and numerical methods employed in the transportation modeling, alongside test tasks to control students ‘progress. Emphasis is given to visualizing calculation outcomes, where the cellular automata model is visualized using Unity 3D. NCL can act as an environment for laboratory works, enabling students to acquire essential professional skills and practical experience in researching current transportation systems.

articleTitle: Theoretical Foundations for Designing an Intelligent System for Container Freight Road Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the basics of a scientific approach to the study of the problems of road container transportation intelligent systems as a subsystem of the road freight transport industry. The system of road container transportation is a structure that includes external and internal links, which are influenced by external and internal environmental factors that determine the information state of the system. The information characteristic of the road container transportation system describes the parametric characteristics of the system, as well as its functional properties, the presence of errors and the principles of their formation. Such information should be formalized when evaluating the parameters of the state of the complex using the methods of system analysis.

articleTitle: Blocking Grid usage for Advance Driver Assist System (ADAS) Evaluations on Proving Ground
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The problem was found during winter test of Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) of Advance Drive Assist System (ADAS) on public roads. It’s coverage of ACC radar working surface by mixture of mud and snow that was “picked up” from road surface by other traffic participants. The result is radar is blind but ACC is still working. The test car can’t see obstacle in front and is can lead to serious collision. To study this situation the public road test method was developed. But this method is very sensitive to weather changes because of mud and snow mixture melts when temperature is above Celsius Degree. To avoid this problem the unified test method was developed. Accordance this method it’s possible to conduct comparison evaluation for different car models with ACC independently from season. Test preparation method was developed. Test equipment is fixed. Each car maneuver during the test is described. Other materials with mud and snow mixture performance was founded. Proving Ground tests will be conducted accordance this test method. The results will be published in separate article.

articleTitle: Development of a Heterogeneous Dynamic Transport System Based on the Bellman Function to Optimize the Process of Planning Automobile Routes
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the development and functionality of a routing protocol aimed at optimizing cargo transportation processes. The Protocol solves the problem of efficient organization of road freight transport in the context of the national transport strategy. It highlights the importance of integrating technological advances and specialized mathematical foundations to optimize routes in a dynamically changing environment. The protocol uses the concept of the Bellman principle and provides a comprehensive approach to route optimization. It can take into account various performance criteria, adapting to the preferences defined by the operating company. The developed analytical model, algorithm, methodology and software make it possible to determine optimal routes in dynamically changing conditions. The model integrates the results of multi-criteria optimization into dynamic programming, allowing you to choose recommended solutions based on the appropriate criteria. The advantages of the developed model are its applicability to complex information and analytical systems with extensive databases and corresponding software. It eliminates formalized links between criteria weights and action alternatives, providing solutions that maximize efficiency when considering the initial values of indicators. In general, the protocol helps to solve problems in the field of cargo transportation, improving the decision-making process by effectively optimizing routes in a dynamic context.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Algorithms for Single, Cluster and Tired Virtual Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Data centers must provide sufficient resources for the smooth operation of applications hosted in them in conditions of variable workload. Resource management is a necessity for guarantee SLA (Service Level Agreements). This paper provides an overview of methods and algorithms for virtual machine allocation in cloud data centers based on the analysis of recent work. The advantages and disadvantages of existing approaches are considered, as well as the requirements that must be met by a universal method of hosting virtual machines that allows overcoming existing limitations. The cloud data center resource management process consists of the following steps: server monitoring, identification of overloaded/underloaded servers, virtual machine selection for migration, destination host selection. Two algorithms for virtual machine selection for migration and destination host selection are proposed. They are suitable for single, cluster and tired virtual machines. These algorithms allow to find an exact solution for the combined criterion of energy efficiency and SLA violation, which is on average 3.5 times better than the widely used FFD (First Fit Decreasing) and BFD (Best Fit Decreasing) heuristics.

articleTitle: Motion Planning of 2D Wheeled Mobile Robot using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper discusses new approaches to planning the movement of a mobile wheeled robot based on the developed new features using the reinforcement learning method. In particular, the problem of “following the leader” is solved, as a subclass of traffic planning problems, using a special simplified 2D environment. The 2D environment has been improved with the addition of dynamic obstacles in order to bring the environment closer to the real conditions of the agent’s functioning and complicate the training configuration to solve the problem of following the leader. Approaches to the configuration of input features to the neural network model are formulated. Neural network models have been obtained for planning the movement of a robotic platform based on training with reinforcement to prevent collisions with dynamic obstacles. The evaluation of the quality of these models was carried out, the efficiency of the methods was demonstrated and shortcomings were identified.

articleTitle: The management of Engineering and Technical Developments in a Regional Environment Based on Ecological-Socio-Economic Information
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The practice of developing and implementing systems for managing socio-economic processes has shown that the scientific community is faced with the task of assessing the diverse environmental, socio-economic, and energy factors of regional development. Such a statement of the problem requires the construction of an interdisciplinary model for managing engineering and technical developments and technologies in a regional environment, decision support, which comprehensively reflects the possibilities and needs of regional development. The study presents the theoretical and methodological foundations of the management of engineering and technical developments and technologies in the regional environment and the management of regional development, which use measurable indicators and methods of system-energy analysis related to the consumption, transformation and distribution of energy resources within the production activities of regional organizational systems. Measurable indicators of the ecological, socio-economic state of the regional system, criteria, description of the dynamics of regional systems are presented. The possibilities of implementing the results of the work are presented in the form of a software (prototype) executed in the Visual Basic for Application as an add-on for the Excel spreadsheet processor. The stages and illustrations of the work of the prototype are presented. The results of the study confirm the applicability and efficiency of the model and prototype based on a unique system of measurable indicators as one of the alternatives in terms of non-monetary assessments, taking into account environmental, socio-economic information. The results of the study are useful in solving the problems of managing technological development, regional information and analytical work.

Author Keywords: management of engineering and technical developments and technologies

articleTitle: Universal Fiber Optic Coupler/Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Based on the analyzes carried out, a universal fiber-optic coupler / sensor has been developed, which allows for smooth feedback adjustment of the output power of the optical radiation source, unauthorized reading of information by receiving electrical pulses generated on the basis of the branched optical radiation, and, depending on the level of the branched optical radiation, to make a connection one of the optical radiation sources with a low attenuation coefficient of the fiber light guide and thereby expand the functionality of the fiber-optic coupler. When developing a universal fiber-optic coupler/sensor, an optical fiber with the greatest susceptibility to macrobending - G655 - was selected as a sensitive element, through which useful information is transmitted. It has been established that an increase in the length of the macrobending arc at a constant radius leads to an increase in the attenuation of optical radiation in the fiber. This dependence is close to linear in the range of macrobending arc lengths from zero to Pi*R

articleTitle: Intellectualization of the Pavement Defect Recognition Process
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A classification of machine learning models and algorithms is presented, and convolutional neural networks are reasonably selected, which have a high ability to recognize patterns in images. Mandatory criteria for selecting a deep learning library and software implementation tools were highlighted to reduce the number of possible choices. A comparative analysis of tools for software implementation and training of neural networks was performed, and the Google Colab service was selected. A description of the specialized application “ImageLabeller”, developed by the authors and used in the process of markup, image filtering, and pixel mask generation, is given. The parameters used by the training algorithm are described. A neural network with DeepLabV3 architecture is chosen as the primary neural network model for 1024×1000 grayscale input images. Examples of recognizing pavement defects by a trained neural network are presented.

articleTitle: Models for Calculating the Pavement Condition Index
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The dependencies for calculating the pavement condition index based on monitoring data collected by mobile complexes for the multi-criteria assessment of the operational condition of street and road network objects “ADS-MADI” are presented. The necessity of considering environmental factors, properties of pavement materials, quality and timing of repair and rehabilitation works, sufficiency of financing volumes when estimating the pavement condition index and forecasting the remaining service life of the pavement has been substantiated. The results of visualization of the monitoring of the Moscow city street and road network objects in 2019–2020 are given in the form of diagrams and on the “heat map”. The resulting pavement condition index values can be used to assess pavement conditions, predict the time required for maintenance and repair activities, and estimate future funding needs.

articleTitle: Rational Use of Dynamic Range in Analog-to-Digital Conversion
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main unsolved problem in the digitization of the audio signal is the preservation of the quality of transmission of low-level signals, which make up about 80% of the duration of the musical heritage. According to the adopted regulatory documents, the signal-to-noise ratio when recording an sound broadcasting signal (SBS) should be 56 dB. Thus, with a 16-bit representation, low-level signals, up to 10 bits, are not sufficiently protected, and from 10 to 16 are redundant. In addition, low-level signals are greatly distorted in the process of analog digital conversion, which also reduces the sound quality. The main decision made today is to increase the bit depth of the signal representation. Formats with 24, 32 bits are used, which makes it possible to increase the security of weak signals to 30–50 dB, but significantly increases the signal volume. The second direction is the use of systems with instantaneous companding (IC) or near instantaneous companding (NIC), which reduce the volume of the transmitted signal, but reduce the assessment of its quality. The authors propose an algorithm for the rational use of dynamic range, which allows maintaining objective quality signal with a decrease in the bit depth of its description. The algorithm is a further development of almost instantaneous companding, the implementation of which became possible with an increase in the speed of audio processor processing and the improvement of signal processing algorithms. The essence of the algorithm is to increase to the maximum signal level before transmission over noise transmission of additional information about the coordinates of each segment and the coefficient of amplification. The simulation confirmed the possibility of maintaining the objective quality of transmission while maintaining or even reducing the bit depth of the signal.

articleTitle: Approaches to Accounting for Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Vehicles in Personal Use
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Currently, a large number of countries are engaged in the inventory of greenhouse gas emissions, it should be noted that the main source of greenhouse gas emissions are processes associated with the burning of fossil fuels. However, with stationary fuel combustion, an inventory of generated emissions is not a difficult task, since almost all enterprises keep records of the consumption of energy resources associated with fuel combustion. At the same time, as is known, in large cities, the main source of greenhouse gas emissions is road transport and if the transport on the balance sheet of enterprises can be subject to fuel consumption accounting, then the transport in personal use is not subject to such accounting. In this connection, the article presents approaches to improve the methods of accounting for greenhouse gas emissions generated by motor vehicles in personal use using machine learning methods on the example of Moscow

articleTitle: Link Level Simulation Model for Vehicles with Location-Aware Beamforming in 5G mm Wave Ultra-Dense Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Beamforming technology, based on the positioning of vehicles in 5G and Beyond 5G (B5G), termed Location-Aware Beamforming (LAB), is a response to the proceeding trend of simultaneous communication sessions spatial density increase in Millimeter Wave (mmWave) Ultra-Dense Networks (UDN). LAB, as part of Location-Aware Communication (LAC), has already gained significant attention in scientific research and development community. However, as far as authors know, there is still no available simulation model for assessment and substantiation of scenarios for LAB in 5G mmWave UDN.
