The contribution of current research is an open-source link level simulation model for vehicles with LAB in 5G mmWave UDN, developed in Matlab environment from primitive functions, available for download and verification.

articleTitle: Methodology for Assessing the Automated Vehicles Safety Based on Operational Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The problem of safety is the main obstacle to the full use and deployment of automated driving technologies. The article describes the weaknesses of automated driving systems and analyzes the principles of safe operation of automated vehicles. The development of safety assessment methods is essential for the safe deployment and operation of automated driving systems. In order to draw up full-fledged conclusions about the level of safety and the effectiveness of making a decision on further improvements, it is necessary to analyze the data on the operation of automated vehicles on public roads. The authors of the article have developed a methodology for the resulting assessment, which is a quantitative and objective method for assessing the safety of automated vehicles. Based on the analysis of the data obtained during each stage of operation, and depending on its results, developers can form requests for the refinement of existing or the development of new design and / or software.

articleTitle: Prospects for the Development of Unmanned Transport Based on 5G and 6G Mobile Communication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article reveals the impact of 5G and 6G mobile communication technologies on the prospects for the development of unmanned transport. Based on the study of the characteristics of unmanned aerial vehicles, connected and unmanned vehicles, the necessity of using the latest mobile communication technologies, the role of information and communication companies in providing digital platforms and services for the development of the transport industry based on 5G and 6G technologies is substantiated. To solve the problem of ensuring the progressive and balanced development of unmanned transport, it is proposed to use the principle of matching the capabilities of mobile applications with the requirements of unmanned transport. An interconnected analysis of the technological and product capabilities of the latest generation mobile communication networks and unmanned transport allowed us to establish the requirements of unmanned transport for the technical parameters of 5G and 6G networks and justify the factors of its strategic development.

Author Keywords: compliance with the requirements of unmanned transport

articleTitle: Information Technologies in Logistic Modeling of Railway Freight Transportation in Port Transport and Technological Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The construction of logistics models intended for calculating options for freight transportation schemes and modeling indicators for the advancement of cargo flows in port transport and technological systems is an important problem in transport research. The work develops an approach to logistics modeling of rail freight transportation carried out within the framework of a multimodal transport and technological system. A mathematical model of the organization and functioning of the logistics link of freight transportation is constructed, which is a multicriteria and multiextremal problem of nonlinear integer programming. The constructed model was implemented on part of the port railway test site. The railway under consideration is characterized by the presence of deep-water ports of the Black Sea. On the specified loop, a link in the logistics chain related to freight transportation is being implemented, ending with the formation of ship lots at one of the portside unloading stations. Compliance with the just-in-time principle is an important element of organizing freight transportation. Along with it, the cost of transportation is of great importance to the client. An algorithm for solving this optimization problem is proposed, through which the distribution of forwarding routes among loading stations is found, at which the optimal values of the cost and time indicators of the freight transportation process are achieved. The idea of the approach is based on the concepts of welfare theory, in particular, the egalitarian approach. Namely, the principle of unanimity of the agents under consideration is implemented using the Pareto optimality criterion. In this case, cost indicators and just-in-time indicator are considered. Turning to the computer algebra system allows you to effectively implement the corresponding computational procedures. As a result, to a greater extent, it is possible to achieve a balance of interests of the considered agents.

articleTitle: Analysis of QAM Constellations with Binary Signal Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper we propose to use a new method of digital modulated signal representation for the analysis of quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) constellations based on an analytical description in the form of function of binary symbols (bits). It is shown that this method of signal representation makes it possible to observe the interaction between bits. It can be used to discover some patterns for further generation of constellations and also to generate new higher order constellations with the same properties.Analysis of well-known constellations for communication systems with coded modulation with bits interleaving BICM (Bit-Interleaved Coded Modulation) using proposed method illustrates the possibilities of the described approach.Here it is shown that for the case of rectangular QAM constellations the description of the signal as a function of binary symbols provides to represent the process of constellation generation in the form of a combination of block non-redundant (primitive) coding with Gray constellation mapping and DAC (digital-to-analog conversion). The described signal representation allows us to solve the task of QAM constellation optimization, finding the optimal block non-redundant code for independent multidimensional binary channel.The simulation shows that even the proposed combination of a simple primitive block code with Gray’s constellation mapping allows to obtain an energy gain about 1–1.5 dB compared to the usual square QAM constellation with Gray’s code and about 0.5–1.25 dB in comparison with known constellations optimized for use in systems with BICM.

articleTitle: Modeling of E-Learning Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In the current socio-economic conditions, e–learning is a very relevant form of the educational process, and the study of its many aspects is an important direction in higher school pedagogy and in pedagogical science in general. In particular, various online educational platforms are rapidly developing today, which, in fact, have made it possible to implement in practice the previously declared principle of learning throughout the active life of a person who now has great opportunities to improve his professional and intellectual development, as well as professional development. Despite the above-mentioned circumstances that determine broad opportunities for learning, there are a number of difficulties in the activities of both educational institutions and online platforms, due to more or less implemented modeling of the educational process implemented using information and communication technologies, the curriculum of which is formed in such a way that it could take part participants with different initial levels of formation of professional competencies (knowledge, skills and abilities). At the same time, the final result achieved as a result of the implementation of training should be very predictable.
